name: Fuenterrobles (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above and blue below, charged with a white fountain at the lower hoist and a green oak at the upper fly.
history: The official flag of Fuenterrobles is of proportions 2:3, party per bend, the first half next to the hoist heraldic blue with a silver fountain, the second half at the fly silver with a green oak; both the fountain and the oak are canting signs referring to the name of the town. The flag was approved by resolution of 21 May 1998 of the Conseller of the Presidency and published in the DOGV of 15 July 1998; the municipality also has a standard of proportions 2:1 approved by resolution of 14 July 1998.
